topology_reasoning.description: Four elliptical lobes emanating from a central junction in a cross pattern. Horizontal lobes have short port stubs, vertical lobes have longer tapered ports. The device has near 4-fold rotational symmetry with asymmetric port lengths.
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: Light enters any port, expands into the central MMI region formed by the overlapping lobes, and splits to all four outputs. The elliptical tapers provide adiabatic mode matching between port waveguides and the multimode junction.
function_knobs: lobe_major_um: controls the ellipse major axis (coupler size, determines splitting ratio)
lobe_minor_um: controls the ellipse minor axis (aperture width at junction)
lobe_overlap_um: how much lobes overlap at center (coupling strength)
topology_reasoning.construction_plan: Create 4 elliptical lobes from polygon points, offset and rotate for cardinal directions, add rectangular ports for horizontal and trapezoidal tapered ports for vertical

iterations.change_made: Initial attempt with 4 identical ellipses + ports
Tried asymmetric H/V lobes - wrong topology
Symmetric lobes, asymmetric port lengths (V longer)
Fine-tuned: smaller lobes (1.0, 0.5), longer H (0.68), shorter V (0.55)
